title: Crispy Air Fryer Potatoes
description: The crispiest homemade fries without deep frying — the baking soda trick makes them perfectly golden and crunchy.

ingredients.text: garlic powder, cayenne pepper, salt, black pepper

steps: Peel and cut potatoes into chunks.
Bring water to a boil; add baking soda and 2 tsp salt. Add potatoes; simmer 10 minutes.
Rinse; add to a bowl with oil and pepper. Shake 30 seconds so edges roughen into a slurry.
Air fry at 180°C / 350°F for 15 minutes. Flip; cook 15 more minutes.
Season with garlic powder, cayenne and salt. Serve.
notes: Avocado Greek yogurt dip is the perfect accompaniment.
